title.zh: 多边形内角和 · 撕下来拼一拼
title.en: Polygon Angle Sums · Tear and Rearrange

description.zh: n 边形内角和 (n−2)×180°，外角和 360°，对平面简单多边形（含凹）成立；曲面上不成立。
description.en: The interior angles of an n-gon add to (n−2)×180° and the exterior angles to 360° for simple plane polygons, convex or concave; not on curved surfaces.

label.en: Exterior angles make one full turn

reason.zh: 沿多边形走一圈累计转 360°，这和单位圆上转一周回到起点是同一个事实。
reason.en: Walking round a polygon turns you through 360°, the same fact as going once round the unit circle back to the start.

title.zh: 为什么多边形内角和是 (n−2)×180°？
title.en: Why is a polygon's angle sum (n − 2) × 180°?

ask.zh: n 边形能分成几个三角形？每个三角形内角和是多少？
ask.en: Into how many triangles can an n-gon be split? What is each triangle's angle sum?

ask.zh: 内角和是 (n−2)×180°，外角和是 360°——绕一圈转过的角度，为什么和边数无关？
ask.en: Interior sums to (n − 2) × 180° and exterior to 360° — why does the total turning around a full loop not depend on the number of sides?

reveal.zh: 从一个顶点连对角线，分成 n−2 个三角形，内角和就是 (n−2)×180°；外角是每步转过的角度，绕一圈总共转 360°，与边数无关。
reveal.en: Diagonals from one vertex split it into n − 2 triangles, giving (n − 2) × 180°; each exterior angle is the turn at one step, and a full loop always turns 360°, whatever the number of sides.
